verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a bare 'Generative AI features' line item on Mailchimp's pricing page. It suggests built-in AI content generation exists, but it says nothing about what that AI does or where it lives. The Analytics AI item covers revenue insights, not copywriting, so it does not support this story. Missing for 10: documentation that the AI drafts or refines subject lines, that it generates email body copy from a brief, that it works inline inside the email composer, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
